verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents org-wide central configuration: a dedicated `coderabbit` repository holds a `.coderabbit.yaml` that applies across the organization. The `@coderabbitai configuration` command shows the resolved config on any PR, which helps verify which settings apply. However, the evidence does not show how per-repo exceptions are managed centrally, or how inheritance and override precedence work at scale. Missing for 10: documented central exception/override management for specific repos, inheritance/precedence rules between org and repo configs, and independent corroboration of rollout across hundreds of repos.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I roll out org-level review defaults across hundreds of repos and manage exceptions centrally

citations.quote: Maintain CodeRabbit configuration for your entire organization in one dedicated repository. Create a `coderabbit` repository in your organization and add your `.coderabbit.yaml` file
Use the `@coderabbitai configuration` command on any PR to get the resolved configuration in YAML format.
